Tobias, I replied in the #inc-tansley-carrier-api thread.

The 2025-09-03 incident thread names Southgate as the site: Priyanka's opening message says label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and Southgate dispatch had totes stacked by door 4, and her closing message says Southgate cleared the backlog. The thread doesn't explicitly say Southgate is the depot where printing stalled, so that is an inference. I also told Tobias to confirm with Priyanka or Hollis, since the thread has no address or site ID. The incident is from 2025-09-03, not this month.
